title: FasterXML/jackson-core#1203: division by 1000 as multiply-and-shift, nothing proved
summary: A pull request that replaces `number / 1000` with `(int) (number * 274_877_907L >>> 38)` in `NumberOutput`. Nothing was proved: each proof pits a 64-bit multiplication against a 32-bit division, and the solver did not finish in its budget or ran out of memory. One witness documents the precondition, `number >= 0`.
verdictLabel: ⚠ unverifiable: solver budget; one precondition witness
notes: Division against multiplication is what exhausts the solver. Next: a pull request to `CharTypes` or `NumberInput` without a division, or `divBy1000` as a verification job with a budget of tens of minutes.
provenance: A real change to a published library, verified with the /verify-bytecode skill; the report is this folder's README.md.
